about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Chana Masala with Fresh Ginger and Coriander
recipes.summary: A North Indian chickpea curry in a tangy tomato and onion gravy, served with rice.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden, add the ginger, garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas with 1/2 cup of water and simmer for 20 minutes until thick. Cook the rice separately until tender.
Finish with the lemon and coriander and serve over the rice.
notes: Vegan and gluten free.

recipes.title: Egyptian-Style Stewed Beans with Lemon, Tahini and Soft Egg
recipes.summary: Stewed beans in the style of ful medames, with cumin, lemon and tahini, served with a boiled egg and flatbread.
steps: Simmer the beans with the garlic, cumin and 1/2 cup of water for 8 minutes until heated through and lightly mashed.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes until the yolks are just set, then peel. Whisk the tahini with half the lemon and 2 tablespoons of water until smooth.
Stir the remaining lemon and the oil through the beans, top with the egg, tahini, tomato and parsley and serve with the flatbread.
notes: Contains egg, gluten and sesame.
Food safety: boil eggs until the whites and yolks are set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Rajma Kidney Bean Curry with Cumin Rice
recipes.summary: A creamy Punjabi-style red kidney bean curry served with cumin rice.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden, add the ginger, garlic and spices for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the beans and 1/2 cup of water and simmer for 20 minutes until thick, mashing a few beans against the pan.
Cook the rice with the cumin seeds until tender and serve with the curry and coriander.
notes: Vegan and gluten free.

recipes.title: Brazilian Bean and Egg Pan with Greens
recipes.summary: A Brazilian-inspired pan of pinto beans, silverbeet, garlic and fried eggs.
steps: Cook the rice. Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the beans and silverbeet and cook for 6 minutes until the greens are wilted and the beans are hot.
Fry or poach the eggs until the whites are set and serve over the beans with the spring onion, lime and rice.
notes: Contains egg.
Food safety: cook eggs until the whites are set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: White Bean and Silverbeet Stew with Rustic Bread
recipes.summary: A thick Tuscan-style stew of cannellini beans, silverbeet and tomato thickened with bread.
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer for 20 minutes until thick, then add the silverbeet for 5 minutes until wilted.
Stir through the bread until it breaks down and thickens the stew and serve topped with the cheese.
notes: Contains gluten and dairy. Skip the cheese for vegan.

recipes.title: Ethiopian-Style Red Lentil Stew with Collard Greens
recipes.summary: A warming, spicy red lentil stew in the style of misir wot, with sauteed greens and injera-style flatbread.
steps: Cook the onions in the oil for 10 minutes until very soft, add the garlic, ginger, spices and paste for 2 minutes.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring, until thick and soft.
Stir through the silverbeet for 4 minutes until wilted and serve with the flatbread.
notes: Contains gluten (flatbread). Add chilli flakes for heat.

recipes.title: Caribbean Red Bean and Sweet Potato Stew with Coconut
recipes.summary: Kidney beans and sweet potato simmered in coconut milk with thyme and allspice, served with rice.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic, ginger, allspice and thyme for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, beans, coconut milk and stock and simmer for 25 minutes until the sweet potato is tender. Cook the rice separately until tender.
Serve over the rice and scatter with the spring onion.
notes: Vegan and gluten free. Use tinned kidney beans; if using dried, soak overnight and boil hard for 10 minutes before simmering.

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Snapper with Celery, Tomato and White Beans
recipes.summary: A Mediterranean fillet of snapper over a warm celery, tomato and cannellini bean base.
steps: Soften the celery in half the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic and tomato for 3 minutes, then the wine, beans and zest and simmer for 6 minutes.
Sear the seasoned fish in the remaining oil, skin side down, for 4 minutes, turn and cook for 2 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Serve the fish on the beans with the parsley.
notes: Contains fish.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Seared Tuna with Salsa Verde and Roast Potatoes
recipes.summary: Seared tuna fillets with a punchy parsley, caper and lemon salsa verde and roasted potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Roast the potato with 2 tablespoons of oil for 25 minutes until crisp.
Blitz the parsley, capers, garlic, lemon and 1/4 cup oil into a rough salsa verde. Steam the beans for 4 minutes until tender.
Sear the tuna in the remaining oil for 2 minutes each side until browned outside and slightly pink within, and serve with the salsa verde, potato and beans.
notes: Contains fish. Choose pole-and-line or sustainably certified tuna.

Food safety: tuna may be served rare in the centre only if very fresh and sashimi-grade; cook through to opaque for children, pregnancy or the elderly. Keep below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Squid and Chorizo Pan with Chickpeas and Lemon
recipes.summary: Quick-seared squid with chorizo and chickpeas in a smoky tomato sauce.
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil for 4 minutes until crisp and the oil turns red, add the onion for 5 minutes, then the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Stir in the squid and cook for 2 minutes until just opaque, then finish with the lemon and parsley.
notes: Squid goes tough past 3 minutes of cooking.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Crab and Lime Fritters with Smashed Avocado
recipes.summary: Pan-fried fritters with crab and sweetcorn, served with a fresh avocado and lime salsa.
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, eggs and milk into a thick batter and fold in the corn, crab and spring onion.
Fry heaped spoonfuls in the oil for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked through, in batches.
Mix the avocado, tomato, lime and coriander and serve on top.
notes: Contains shellfish, gluten, egg and dairy.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Slow-Braised Beef Cheek Ragu with Pappardelle
recipes.summary: Tender beef cheeks braised in tomato and red wine, shredded through ribbon pasta.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan). Brown the beef in the oil in batches and set aside.
Soften the onion and carrot for 6 minutes, add the garlic, wine, tomatoes, stock and rosemary, return the beef, cover and braise for 2.5 hours until the cheeks fall apart.
Shred the beef into the sauce. Boil the pappardelle for 9 minutes until al dente and toss with the ragu and parmesan.
notes: Contains gluten, dairy and egg.
Food safety: beef must be cooked until tender and well above 75°C; cool leftovers quickly, refrigerate within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Black Pepper Beef Heart and Mushroom Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Thin slices of lean beef heart stir-fried hot and fast with mushrooms and black pepper sauce.

items: 500g beef heart, trimmed and thinly sliced

steps: Cook the rice until tender. Toss the beef heart with the cornflour.
Stir-fry the beef in half the oil in a very hot wok for 3 minutes until browned and cooked through, then set aside. Stir-fry the mushroom, capsicum and garlic in the remaining oil for 4 minutes.
Return the beef with the soy, oyster sauce and pepper for 1 minute and serve over the rice with spring onion.
notes: Heart is a lean muscle, not tough if sliced thinly and cooked quickly. Contains soy, gluten and shellfish.
Food safety: cook offal until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Peri-Peri-Style Chicken Livers with Garlic Bread
recipes.summary: A South African-Portuguese favourite: chicken livers in a warm chilli and cream sauce with garlic bread.
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, add the garlic and the livers and cook for 4 minutes until browned.
Add the chilli, cream and lemon and simmer for 3 minutes until the livers are cooked through with no pink.
Toast the baguette with the butter until golden and serve with the livers and parsley.
notes: Contains gluten and dairy. Avoid in pregnancy due to high vitamin A.
Food safety: cook liver until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Tofu with Sweet Chilli and Sesame Greens
recipes.summary: Oven-baked tofu cubes in a sticky sweet chilli glaze with sesame broccolini and rice.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the tofu in the soy, cornflour and oil and bake on a tray for 25 minutes until golden and crisp, turning once.
Cook the rice. Steam the broccolini for 4 minutes until tender and toss with the sesame oil and seeds.
Toss the hot tofu with the sweet chilli sauce for 1 minute and serve with the greens and rice.
notes: Contains soy, sesame and gluten.

recipes.title: Braised Tofu and Mushroom Claypot-Style Rice
recipes.summary: Rice, tofu, shiitake and greens cooked together in one pot with a caramelised soy base.
steps: Brown the tofu in the oil for 6 minutes until golden, add the mushroom, garlic and ginger for 4 minutes.
Stir in the rice, soy, oyster sauce and stock, cover and cook gently for 15 minutes until the rice is nearly tender.
Lay the bok choy on top, cover for 5 minutes until wilted and drizzle with sesame oil.
notes: Contains soy, gluten, sesame and shellfish. Use vegetarian mushroom sauce for a vegan version.

recipes.title: Eggplant and Lentil Moussaka-Style Bake
recipes.summary: A plant-based moussaka layered with lentil ragu, grilled eggplant and a creamy yoghurt topping.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Brush the eggplant with oil and roast for 20 minutes until golden.
Soften the onion in a little oil, add the garlic, lentils, tomatoes, stock and cinnamon and simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are tender and thick.
Layer the eggplant and lentils in a dish. Whisk the eggs, yoghurt and half the cheese, pour over, top with the remaining cheese and bake for 25 minutes until golden and set.
notes: Contains egg and dairy.
Food safety: bake until the egg topping is set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
